crossRefs.note: Now this was the custom in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning exchanging, to confirm all things…
So the near kinsman said to Boaz, “Buy it for yourself,” then he took off his sandal.
at that time Yahweh spoke by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, “Go, and loosen the sackcloth from off your waist, and…
He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the thong of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop…
He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”
Yahweh said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up…
They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.
I gave my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who plucked off the hair. I didn’t hide my face from shame…
Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,
They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.
They will mock him, spit on him, scourge him, and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”
Judah said to Onan, “Go in to your brother’s wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her, and raise up…
Moreover, Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, I have purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead on…
All the people who were in the gate, and the elders, said, “We are witnesses. May Yahweh make the woman who has come…
“Therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘I said indeed that your house and the house of your father should walk…

translations.web: then his brother’s wife shall come to him in the presence of the elders, and loose his sandal from off his foot, and spit in his face. She shall answer and say, “So shall it be done to the man who does not build up his brother’s house.”
translations.bsb: his brother’s widow shall go up to him in the presence of the elders, remove his sandal, spit in his face, and declare, “This is what is done to the man who will not maintain his brother’s line.”
translations.kjv: Then shall his brother's wife come unto him in the presence of the elders, and loose his shoe from off his foot, and spit in his face, and shall answer and say, So shall it be done unto that man that will not build up his brother's house.
translations.asv: then shall his brother's wife come unto him in the presence of the elders, and loose his shoe from off his foot, and spit in his face; and she shall answer and say, So shall it be done unto the man that doth not build up his brother's house.
